the common tasks and can be called on to run the main aspects of all the sub-scripts.
	
Main targets:

 autoclean                   Checks if a change in the build or deplist neccessitates a clean
 changelog.build             Turns the current changelog (doc/changelog.markdown) into HTML
 clean                       Removes all generated files.
 clean.dist                  Deletes everything that this build script has ever generated.
 compile                     Compiles the code
 compile.support             Compiles code that is used solely by the build, such as website and IDE project creation
 create.spiProcessor         Compiles the services file generating processor
 deps                        Downloads all dependencies needed for common tasks

 eclipse.testtarget.eclipse  Makes an eclipse launch target for running the tests for eclipse support

 help                        Start here!
 intellij                    Creates intellij project files and downloads all dependencies. Open this directory as a project in IntelliJ after running this target
 javadoc.build               Generates the javadoc
 latest-changes.build        Creates the latest changes HTML file from the markdown in doc/changelog
 make.javac-patch-jar        to test javac13 on JDK14, for example, you need a jar (not a jmod), to use with --patch-modules. This task makes those.
 mapstructBinding.maven      Create a maven repo for mapstruct binding into a build dir.
 maven                       Creates a maven repo for the current release into a build dir. The intent is for you to put that on a server someplace. Will invoke your local mvn installation.
 maven.edge                  Create a maven repo for the current snapshot into a build dir. The intent is for you to put that on a server someplace. Will invoke your local mvn installation.
 test                        runs the tests against the default JVM, javac, and eclipse
 test.broad                  runs the tests against the default JVM, javac, and eclipse
 test.compile                compiles the tests
 test.ecj11                  runs the tests on your default VM, testing the ecj11 release
 test.ecj11.call             Runs a few ecj-specific tests
 test.ecj14                  runs the tests on your default VM, testing the ecj11 release
 test.ecj16                  runs the tests on your default VM, testing the ecj11 release
 test.eclipse-202006         runs the tests on your default VM, testing the 2020-06 release of eclipse

 test.eclipse-oxygen         runs the tests on your default VM, testing the oxygen release of eclipse
 test.instance               Runs test cases for the swe-bench instance
 test.javac11                runs the tests on your default VM, using javac11 as underlying compiler
 test.javac14                runs the tests on your default VM, using javac14 as underlying compiler
 test.javac16                runs the tests on your default VM, using javac16 as underlying compiler
 test.javac6                 runs the tests on your default VM, using javac6 as underlying compiler
 test.javac8                 runs the tests on your default VM, using javac8 as underlying compiler
 test.javacCurrent           runs the tests on your default VM, using its javac as underlying compiler
 version                     Shows the version number
 website.build               Builds the website based on current live version
 website.open                Builds the website, then serves it locally, opening a browser.
 website.print-live-version  Print the current version of lombok available from projectlombok.org
 website.publish             Builds the website, compresses it, sends it to the projectlombok.org server and deploys it

part.text:
Fixed and verified. Summary:

**Root cause:** In `JavacHandlerUtil.clearTypes` (src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/JavacHandlerUtil.java:1997), the `TreeScanner` override assigned `tree.type = null` without a null check. When an `onConstructor_` annotation argument contains an array initializer like `{"test"}`, javac parses it as a `JCNewArray` with a null `elemtype`, and the scanner's `visitNewArray` passes that null child back into `scan`, causing the NPE.

**Fix:** Null-check the tree before clearing its type in `scan` (JavacHandlerUtil.java:1996-2002).

**Validation:**
- Without the fix, the issue's reproduction compiles with the exact reported NPE stack trace
- With the fix, `javac -cp lombok.jar TestClass.java` succeeds
- `ant test.instance` passes: 368 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors
